entities.summary: Asander (109 BCE - 16 BCE) was a prominent economist or social scientist of the Classical era, active in the Global region. He is known for his contributions to the understanding of monarchs and rulers, particularly in the context of the Roman Empire. Asander's work was instrumental in shaping the economic and social structures of the time, influencing the development of various civilizations. His legacy can be seen in the continued study of monarchies and their impact on global politics. Asander's significance lies in his ability to provide valuable insights into the economic and social dynamics of the Classical era, making him a crucial figure in understanding the historical context of this period.
